description: Mandatory deterministic fixture (CLAUDE.md, docs/07 §3). Canonical state hashes for the fixed seed + DEFAULT_CONFIG + the fixed command log below (one command of every intervention kind, Milestone 9). Intentional engine behavior changes require an ENGINE_VERSION bump, regenerated hashes (pnpm headless --seed 0xE0A12026 --ticks 10000 --checkpoints 0,1,10,100,1000,10000 --fixture-commands) and a CHANGELOG entry. Engine 0.7.0 regenerated every hash: the canonical stream gained the founder region and the command log, event payloads became signed 32-bit words, the config gained the interventions section, and the fixture now RUNS the command log — the trajectory legitimately diverges from 0.6.0 once the first command applies at tick 50 (by tick 10000: population 4381 vs 4364, 26 drowning deaths from the flooded LOWER_TERRAIN stroke, a meteor crater at the founder centre). Tick 0 and 1 differ from 0.6.0 only through the hash-stream and config changes; the organism trajectory is identical until the first command applies. Engine 0.8.0 regenerated every hash again, for two intentional authoritative changes (ADR 0025): the expected-gain food-target rule replaced the categorical carcass gate (docs/04 §20 as amended), and the plant capacities were calibrated to 0.6x the v0.1 hypothesis (docs/08 §5 as amended, closing L11). The tick-0 hash moves through the config digest alone; the trajectory diverges once feeding decisions begin. The 0.8.0 calibration also moves carcass decay 20 -> 48 (docs/08 §15 as amended). By tick 10000 the leaner, scavenging world holds population 1003 (was 4381), 1382 live carcasses under the 4096 cap (was pinned at it), and has eaten 511.4k meat units (was 0 on the pre-policy reference world).
